verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog and search API whose MCP server connects to Claude, ChatGPT and similar assistants, so agent checkout is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only covers product discovery and lookup, plus affiliate buy URLs where sales are recorded and attributed. Nothing shows buyers completing a purchase inside the chat surface, and nothing shows a merchant-facing way to enable in-chat checkout; the UCP integration is described only for search and lookup.
